request.style: English, soulful male solo voice with gospel choir, piano, organ, drums, bass, strings, hopeful yet solemn mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eighteen years old when he sat the throne
Reigned in Jerusalem for just three months
His mother Nehushta from the city gates
He did evil in the Lord's own sight

[Verse]
Nebuchadnezzar marched against the city wall
Officers laid siege to hold the land tight
The king of Babylon came to press the siege
Jehoiachin surrendered with his mother there

[Chorus]
Taken to Babylon with the gold
Ten thousand captives left the city old
Treasures stripped from Solomon's house of God
Recorded as childless by the word of God

[Verse]
Thirty-seven years in prison dark
Evil-merodach spoke to him with care
A seat of honor among kings in Babylon
He ate at the king's table each day

[Chorus]
Taken to Babylon with the gold
Ten thousand captives left the city old
Treasures stripped from Solomon's house of God
Recorded as childless by the word of God

[Bridge]
Yet in Matthew's genealogy he appears
Jechoniah father of Shealtiel there
A line of descendants through the exile long
God's covenant holds firm and endures strong

[Chorus]
Taken to Babylon with the gold
Ten thousand captives left the city old
Treasures stripped from Solomon's house of God
Recorded as childless by the word of God

[Outro]
From prison cell to the royal table
Faithfulness remains in the valley
